title: E-GRV-0050: the bulk gravity screening is a clean size-independent spectral gap, not a finite-size artifact: the...
purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0050 in the gravity arena: the bulk gravity screening is a clean size-independent spectral gap, not a finite-size artifact: the random-walk decay rate (spectral radius) on {3,4,3,4} is 0.572 at BOTH 9000 and 170000 cells (size-independent), well below one (a gap, Yukawa mass -ln(0.572)), while the flat lattice rate rises toward one (no gap, no screening), upgrading the earlier size-dependent Green's-function drop.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
